name: William F. Meier
bioAdditions: The 'Florence Irene Meier' buried from Wilkes-Barre in October 1933 was not William's daughter. She was his niece, Florence Irene Meier (b. 15 Mar 1916 Wilkes-Barre, d. 9 Oct 1933 Wilkes-Barre, aged 17), the eldest child of his brother Fred Aloysius Meier Sr. and Anna Mather. The FamilySearch tree attaches her to Fred's household in the 1920 and 1930 censuses and to a Find a Grave index entry at St. Mary's Cemetery, Hanover Twp. (S1). William's father Henry J. Meier did not die in 1940: he was still living, aged 83, at 16 Barney Street in the 1950 census (S2). So William was 46 when his father died, in December 1950 (see Henry J. Meier).

openQuestionsResolved.question: Was 'Florence Irene Meier' (funeral Oct 1933) his infant daughter?
openQuestionsResolved.answer: No. She was his niece, Florence Irene Meier (15 Mar 1916–9 Oct 1933), daughter of his brother Fred Aloysius Meier Sr. and Anna Mather. She was 17, not an infant.
